execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."abonnement" (
  "date_debut" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "date_fin" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "formule_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "utilisateur_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_log" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "date" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "informations_complementaires" text,
  "utilisateur_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."conversation" (
  "date_creation" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "professionnel_id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "voyageur_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_echange" (
  "conversation_id" text NOT NULL,
  "date_envoi" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expediteur_id" text NOT NULL,
  "fichier" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_verification" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "fichier" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "professionnel_id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "type_document" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."formule_abonnement" (
  "duree" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "nom" text NOT NULL,
  "prix" int4 NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "type_utilisateur" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."message" (
  "contenu" text NOT NULL,
  "conversation_id" text NOT NULL,
  "date_envoi" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expediteur_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."paiement" (
  "abonnement_id" text NOT NULL,
  "date_confirmation" timestamptz,
  "date_creation" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "montant" int4 NOT NULL,
  "moyen_paiement" text NOT NULL,
  "reference" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."professionnel" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "informations_professionnelles" text,
  "nom_structure" text NOT NULL,
  "statut_verification" text NOT NULL,
  "utilisateur_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."publication" (
  "contenu" text NOT NULL,
  "date_creation" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date_publication" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "professionnel_id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "titre" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signalement" (
  "cible_id" text NOT NULL,
  "date_creation" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "motif" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "type_cible" text NOT NULL,
  "utilisateur_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."utilisateur" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mot_de_passe" text NOT NULL,
  "nom" text NOT NULL,
  "prenom" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  "telephone" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."verification" (
  "commentaire" text,
  "date_debut" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date_decision" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "professionnel_id" text NOT NULL,
  "statut" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
